components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action on every screen (Request a Call).
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.75rem; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-accent, #00b5c9); color: var(--color-background, #2b2b2b); padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn:active { filter: brightness(0.92); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00b5c9; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn:disabled { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color: #b6b6b6; cursor: not-allowed; filter: none; }

components.name: Text Link Button
components.description: Secondary action that opens a dialog (the intake form).
components.css: .ds-text-link { appearance: none; background: none; border: none; padding: 0; font: inherit; color: #00b5c9; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 3px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-text-link:hover { color: #e6e6e6; } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00b5c9; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field in the lead forms.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.35rem; } .ds-field span { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #b6b6b6; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-input { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #b6b6b6 60%, #353535); border-radius: 6px; color: #e6e6e6; font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; padding: 0.65rem 0.85rem; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: color-mix(in srgb, #b6b6b6 92%, #353535); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #00b5c9; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, #00b5c9 15%, transparent); }

components.name: Raised Panel
components.description: The one raised surface on a screen.

components.css: .ds-log { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 1.25rem; background: #353535; border-radius: 10px; } .ds-log li { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 4.75rem 1fr; column-gap: 1rem; padding: 0 0 1rem 1.25rem; } .ds-log li::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0.4rem; width: 0.55rem; height: 0.55rem; background: #00b5c9; } .ds-log li.ds-log--out::after { background: #ff2d8a; } .ds-log time { grid-row: 1 / 3; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #b6b6b6; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-log b { font-weight: 650; color: #e6e6e6; } .ds-log span { font-size: 0.9375rem; color: #b6b6b6; }

narrative.overview: A local shop that keeps a small business running after hours. The room is dark charcoal, and the light comes from the work itself: Edge Cyan, the color of the logo, is the working signal, and Runner Pink is the occasional spark. The tone is practical and capable rather than flashy, the way a good tradesperson's van is clean and clearly lettered rather than chromed.
keyCharacteristics: One type family, Archivo, condensed for headings and normal width for reading.
Edge Cyan leads; Runner Pink appears once per screen at most.
Small, firm corners (2–10px) that sit with the angular "ER" logo.
No glows, no gradients, no decorative cards.

rules.name: The Locked Palette Rule
rules.body: The hex values above are fixed by the owner. Fixes change where and how much a color is used, never the values. New colors may be proposed as optional additions, never as replacements.

rules.name: The Cyan Leads Rule
rules.body: Edge Cyan is the lead accent because it is the logo. Runner Pink is rare: at most one pink moment per screen, used for the thing that most deserves a second look.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: No colored shadows, drop-shadow halos or gradient fills. Depth comes from Raised Charcoal and hairlines; the only shadow is the neutral one under dialogs.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Archivo only. Hierarchy comes from width, weight and size together, never from a second face.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Running text stops at 65ch; headings use text-wrap: balance, paragraphs text-wrap: pretty.

dos: Do keep every palette value exactly as listed in the frontmatter (The Locked Palette Rule).
Do use solid Edge Cyan with Shop Charcoal text for the primary action.
Do group with space and hairlines before reaching for a panel.
Do label any illustrative example as illustrative.
donts: Don't swap, re-hue, or replace the brand colors.
Don't use Runner Pink for small text, links or labels.
Don't add glows, gradient fills, colored shadows or side-stripe borders (The No Glow Rule).
Don't show invented numbers, testimonials or client logos.
Don't put white text on Edge Cyan (2.5:1).
